article.hook: When no one looks your way, it feels like you don’t exist. Lilith in Leo makes invisibility unbearable, pushing us to claim the stage by any means necessary.
article.lived: For nearly nine months, the need to be seen swells like a spotlight aimed too close. People stretch their stories, spark drama, or dial up confidence until the room turns toward them. We know the ache when a moment passes without notice, and we scramble to fill the silence with something undeniable, even if it’s loud or reckless.
article.turn: The problem starts when the show becomes the only thing that matters. When pride puffs up to cover shame, applause isn’t enough - control is. We bend stories, hijack conversations, and make everything about our pain. Stop performing for ghosts; the real wound is not being seen, but pretending to be someone you’re not.
